title: Sideways shift experiment 2: five ways (G-K)
intro: No reset needed. Stand still in the open, hands off. Remember which letters slid the camera and whether nametags flickered. Shift+End stops it.

steps.text: Hands off - co-op OFF. Watch if the camera slides sideways.

steps.each_frame:
if not CAMH then
  CAMH = { mode = "" }
  local function bump(obj, f, x) local v = obj:get_field(f); v.x = v.x + x; obj:set_field(f, v) end
  local function this_of(args) return sdk.to_managed_object(args[2]) end
  local root = sdk.find_type_definition("app.PlayerCameraControllerRoot")
  local base = sdk.find_type_definition("app.CameraControllerBase")
  local function hook(td, name, pre, post)
    local m = td:get_method(name)
    CAMH["has_" .. name] = m ~= nil
    if not m then return end
    sdk.hook(m, function(args)
      thread.get_hook_storage().this = this_of(args)
      if pre then pcall(pre, thread.get_hook_storage().this) end
    end, function(ret)
      if post then pcall(post, thread.get_hook_storage().this) end
      return ret
    end)
  end
  hook(base, "applyOffsetParam", function(o)
    CAMH.n_apply = (CAMH.n_apply or 0) + 1
    if CAMH.mode == "G" then
      local m = o:call("get_MixedOffsetParam")
      local v = m:get_field("_POG"); v.x = 3.0; m:set_field("_POG", v)
      v = m:get_field("_Position"); v.x = 3.0; m:set_field("_Position", v)
    end
  end)
  hook(root, "updatePog", function(o)
    CAMH.n_pog = (CAMH.n_pog or 0) + 1
  end, function(o)
    if CAMH.mode == "H" then bump(o, "_Pog", 3.0) end
  end)
  hook(root, "updatePosition", function(o)
    CAMH.n_pos = (CAMH.n_pos or 0) + 1
    if CAMH.mode == "I" then bump(o, "_Pog", 3.0) end
  end, function(o)
    if CAMH.mode == "J" then bump(o, "_Pog", 3.0); bump(o, "_Position", 3.0) end
    if CAMH.mode == "K" then bump(o, "_Position", 3.0) end
  end)
end
